description: This is a PHP source file for the Opencart administrative controller managing localisation of geo zones. It contains class definition for GeoZone extending the base Controller class, with methods for listing, viewing, editing, and saving geo zone data within the admin interface.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation of geographical zones within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the geo zones list page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing of geo zones, returning JSON or view output depending on context.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of geo zones according to sorting, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Alias for getList, outputs the list directly.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a geo zone.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of geo zone data, creating or updating record based on input.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected geo zones, with permission checks and JSON response.
